scope: Explicit fact-source binding readiness audit for the protocol-owned ShipDeck lifecycle coordinator after T-FO06CO

confirmedSeams: server-only OnNetworkSpawn registers the NPC ship in NpcShipZoneRegistry and NpcShipWorld
missing explicit npcInstanceId currently falls back to NetworkObjectId
NpcShipController.factRole: reviewed ShipRegistered and ship-invalidating boundary candidate only

confirmedSeams: SpawnMember creates a crew NetworkObject and calls NGO Spawn(destroyWithScene=true)
existing crew reuse and stale local-map cleanup use current runtime checks including IsSpawned
server-only OnNetworkDespawn clears the local map
attachment requires spawned ship, successful parent attachment and ShipDeckNav.IsReady
server-only DetachFromShipDeck clears attachment and ride state
NpcBrain.factRole: reviewed explicit PassengerAttached and PassengerDetached completion fact candidate only

confirmedSeams: server-side OnNetworkSpawn queues asynchronous NavMesh registration
ShipDeckNav.registrationGenerationRole: NavMesh registration lifecycle only; never a protocol identity or attachment/lifetime generation

GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionH.factRole: downstream consumer of coordinator-produced reviewed lifecycle binding receipt
GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionH.bindingRule: must not consume direct callbacks from the four source seams
GlobalMotionShipDeckCombinedTransactionH.hostLocalBindingGeneration: binding/snapshot provenance only; not protocol identity or coordinator generation

ingressMatrix.requiredFact: server-accepted ship registration with stable protocol ShipId, supplemental ShipNetworkObjectId only as a cross-check, new lifetime boundary, server ownership and protocol ownership
ingressMatrix.coordinatorOutput: opens ship ledger, issues strictly monotonic never-reused ShipLifetimeGeneration and first contiguous ledger ordinal
rejects: identity inferred from IsSpawned or NetworkObjectId

ingressMatrix.requiredFact: server-accepted crew/passenger ingress plus completed NpcBrain attachment, stable passenger identity, matching ShipId/lifetime, explicit new AttachmentGeneration, parent completion, ShipDeckNav.IsReady, server/protocol ownership
ingressMatrix.coordinatorOutput: opens active passenger attachment epoch and issues strictly monotonic AttachmentGeneration with next contiguous ledger ordinal

ingressMatrix.requiredFact: server-confirmed completed detach for exact active ship/passenger attachment epoch with stable identities, matching lifetime, exact AttachmentGeneration, ownership and next ordinal
ingressMatrix.coordinatorOutput: closes the matching active attachment epoch; source generation becomes unavailable; later attach requires a greater explicit generation

ingressMatrix.requiredFact: server/protocol terminal ship despawn or invalidation boundary with stable ShipId, matching lifetime, explicit reason, ownership, terminal order and accounting for open passenger epochs
ingressMatrix.coordinatorOutput: closes ship lifetime, records terminal reason and last ledger order, forbids all later attach/detach receipts; recreate requires a new lifetime generation
rejects: synthetic replacement by passenger detach callbacks

inheritedPureValidationEvidenceOnly.meaning: inherited contract/coordinator validation only; not evidence of runtime caller binding, live producer output, NGO ordering, provider readiness or rollback

nextGate: separate owner-reviewed implementation and serial binding of explicit server/protocol facts; no inference-based adapter or host binding
